largest_directory.disposition: Retained forensic journal/evidence; findings are largely phone, postal-code, wallet-shaped text, and compliance references. Evidence retention is an explicit project constraint. Individual evidence hits were not all reviewed; this scan is not clean and Phase 41.2 remains open.

No confirmed secret exposure was found.

Two medium username matches are temporary account-variable names. Two critical XML external-entity patterns point to the standard Apple property-list DOCTYPE emitted by package-macos.sh; this script generates the plist and does not parse untrusted XML.
